title: Moving the Monthly Due Date on a Retail Installment Contract
content:
**Conditions.** On Retail Installment Contracts, a due-date change is made only on a contract whose status is active. The borrower asks for the new due day by phone or in writing; no signature and no fee are required. On the request date the contract must have at least the tier's minimum installments paid for a due-date change and be no more than the tier's maximum days past due for a due-date change. Changes already made may not reach the tier's maximum changes in the rolling 12 months or its maximum changes over the contract's life.

**The new date.** The new due day must lie within the allowed due-day range. The new next due date is the first date carrying the new due day that is later than the current next due date; it may be no more than the tier's maximum shift in calendar days later than the current next due date, and a due date is never moved earlier.

**The final installment.** The final installment date moves to the new due day in the month that is (remaining installments minus 1) months after the new next due date.

**Payment and interest.** The scheduled payment does not change; simple interest accrues for the added days and is collected through the ordinary order of payment application.

**Measures.** Installments paid are the whole calendar months from the first payment date to the next due date, less the installments deferred by every extension. Days past due are the calendar days from the next due date to the request date when the next due date is earlier, and 0 otherwise. Changes in the rolling 12 months are counted by the date each change was made, from records dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before (the last day of that month when that day does not exist).

**Worked cases (hypothetical contract, next due date 10 March, 20 installments remaining, a 15-day shift limit).**

| Requested due day | New next due date | Days later | Within the shift limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 22nd | 22 March | 12 | yes; final installment on 22 October of the following year (19 months after March) |
| 5th | 5 April | 26 | no |
| 30th | — | — | no; outside the allowed range of the 1st to the 28th |

A borrower whose current due day is the 10th cannot move it to the 8th of the same month, since a due date is never moved earlier.
